# Shared Workflow Instructions

This repository's shared runtime policy is defined in [../instructions/docker-runtime.instructions.md](../instructions/docker-runtime.instructions.md).

This repository's shared git/docs sanity policy is defined in [../instructions/git-docs-sanity.instructions.md](../instructions/git-docs-sanity.instructions.md).

Use both policies for profile tasks. Together they cover container-first execution, repo-scoped mounts, non-root usage, rebuild/cleanup, and git/docs/push sanity checks.

Profile mapping is maintained in [model-profile-map.md](model-profile-map.md).
